component.name: cmux
component.summary: Terminal workspaces and split panes for AI coding agents

description.p: A native GTK terminal for developers who run several shells and terminal coding agents at once. Inspired by cmux for macOS.

ul.li: Vertical workspace sidebar with git branch, working directory and listening ports
Nested horizontal and vertical split panes with keyboard navigation
Notification rings, unread badges and jump-to-unread for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Qoder and OpenCode hooks
Command palette, configurable shortcuts, themes and fonts
CLI and local Unix-socket API for automation
Workspace and layout restoration, optional tmux-backed persistent sessions

description.p: First release: terminals, workspaces, splits, notifications, agent hooks, CLI, sessions.
